title: The household or the groom?
odia: ଘର ଦେଖି ଦେଇ କି, ବର ଦେଖି ଦେଇ
literal_meaning: Is the marriage arranged by looking at the household, or at the groom?
explanation: The question contrasts a family’s standing with the individual being considered for marriage. It exposes two different ways of judging a match.
meaning_odia: ବିବାହ ବେଳେ ପରିବାରର ପରିଚୟକୁ ଦେଖାଯାଉଛି, ନା ବରକୁ ନିଜେ—ଏହି ଦୁଇ ମାନଦଣ୍ଡର ତଫାତ ଏଠି ଉଠିଛି।
usage_example: A discussion of a prospective marriage dwells on the family name while saying little about the person. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary places ଘର under high family. That records a status-conscious setting, not an endorsement of inherited rank; the saying does not establish either person’s consent.
